diagnosis: SilkRecordedPayloadDetailView queries django-silk's Request model by request_id without verifying that the logged profiling record belongs to the requesting user's session. Silk captures raw HTTP request bodies, authorization headers, and cookies. Any authenticated user who obtains or enumerates a request UUID can read other users' plaintext credentials, API tokens, and personal data.
